item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
The Microsoft voice is now reliable: when Microsoft's server is busy, the app retries instead of switching to the robotic voice or stopping mid-read.

New: Kokoro, a natural voice that runs on your Mac (Settings > Kokoro). English only; Hebrew stays on the Microsoft voice. One-time ~465 MB download.

New: Volume slider in Settings, and all voices are now louder and play at the same level.
